answer: Persistent Query Obligation.** Each agent identity must answer randomized challenge queries about its own past work within strict latency bounds; unanswered queries decay reputation. Agents post a walnut-sized escrow that funds the querying neighbors, so abandoning an identity forfeits it. Because maintaining many identities requires sustained real-time answering, an attacker pays continuous attention costs, not a one-time fee. Honest agents earn nectar through consistent responses, while a fake lantern identity must answer every challenge or lose escrow.
